name: Dr Fazle Rabbi
contribution: Dr Fazle Rabbi was a physician and intellectual who was abducted and killed during the targeted December 1971 killings of professionals in Dhaka.
context: The abductions took place at the end of the Liberation War, when journalists, teachers, doctors, and other civic figures were targeted in an effort to damage the intellectual capacity of the emerging country.
impact: Rabbi's death is part of the historical record of targeted attacks on Bangladesh's educated civic leadership and the enduring memory of Martyred Intellectuals Day.
highlight: A healer lost in the war’s final atrocity phase.
